value.rationale: The natural extreme-oscillation limit measures how long environmentally driven strategy cycles take when trajectories become near-pure in cooperation and environmental state. A sharp universal physical-time coefficient independent of payoff and community mixing is not obtainable from knowing periodic-orbit existence; it supplies a robust quantitative prediction for the source model, and the assumptions preserve two independently evolving edge environments.
